description: Knowledge base CRUD, sync, and session-start hydration. Actions: "list" (browse entries), "read" (get entry content), "write" (create/update entry, auto git sync), "delete" (remove entry, auto git sync), "sync" (manual git pull + push), "wakeup" (return token-budgeted section-priority context bundle — identity, active_tasks, recent_decisions, known_gotchas, last_session_summary, top_weighted, semantic_fallback — call once at session start).

category.description: Category (action=list: filter; action=write: target directory). One of: projects, people, decisions, workflows, notes

content.description: Full markdown content for the entry (action=write)

filename.description: Filename with or without .md extension (action=write), e.g. 'my-project.md'

path.description: Relative path to the entry, e.g. 'projects/my-project.md' (action=read, delete)

section_budgets.description: [wakeup] Per-section token-budget overrides, e.g. {"identity": 200, "top_weighted": 400}. Unspecified sections split the remainder evenly. Unused budget redistributes to later sections.

sections.description: [wakeup] Comma-separated, ordered section list. Valid: identity, active_tasks, recent_decisions, known_gotchas, last_session_summary, top_weighted, semantic_fallback. Default: all seven in that order. Omit to preserve v1.8.0 behaviour.

token_budget.description: [wakeup] Max tokens to render (chars/4 estimate, default 800)

name: knowledge
